gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients present with histologically confirmed diagnosis of an H3.1K27M or H3.3K27M-mutated diffuse midline glioma WHO grade IV

candidate_evidence.quote: 14 doses of the human anti-PD-L1 antibody Atezolizumab/ Tecentriq® (every three weeks, q3w) starting four weeks after completion of RT
Based on these observations we hypothesize that checkpoint inhibition targeting PD-L1 is required for optimal amplification of a vaccine-induced H3K27M-specific T cell response.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: No previous treatment except for surgery

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: The primary immunogenicity endpoint is the presence of an H3K27M-specific T-cell response. H3K27M-specific T cell responses are measured on Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells (PBMC) using IFN-gamma ELISpot.

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Tecentriq 1200 MG in 20 ML Injection (other names: Atezolizumab)
The aim of this phase I trial is to evaluate the safety and immune response to the H3K27M peptide vaccine in combination with Atezolizumab in patients with H3K27M-mutant diffuse midline gliomas.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: checkpoint inhibition targeting PD-L1 is required for optimal amplification of a vaccine-induced H3K27M-specific T cell response

role_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] H3K27M peptide vaccine: The H3K27M peptide vaccine is injected subcutaneously (s.c.).

agents.drug_class_hint: long peptide neoantigen cancer vaccine containing K27M-mutated histone-3 sequence

role_evidence.quote: The H3K27M peptide vaccine is administered in combination with topical Imiquimod that serves as an adjuvant.

agents.drug_class_hint: topical TLR7 agonist used as vaccine adjuvant (Aldara cream)

flag.reason: Imiquimod is a vaccine adjuvant applied at the injection site; no own antitumour hypothesis stated, but it is not symptom control either; could be considered part of the excluded vaccine or an investigational immune agonist.

source_quote.quote: Tumoral H3.1K27M or H3.3K27M mutation proven by immunohistochemistry or H3 DNA sequencing

coder_notes: Adult H3K27M-mutant diffuse midline glioma only; glioblastoma appears only in keywords, so not_glioblastoma (fails S5). Candidate status coded anyway: atezolizumab is the only investigational non-vaccine drug (vaccine = excluded type), analogous to the pembrolizumab + vaccine worked example. H3K27M eligibility biomarker is matched to the vaccine antigen (an excluded intervention), not to atezolizumab, so candidate_matched false. Target engagement coded unclear: immunogenicity (H3K27M-specific T-cell response by ELISpot) is primarily a vaccine endpoint, though the rationale ties PD-L1 blockade to amplifying it. Radiotherapy is standard background, not an agent.
